seed: At Next defaults, no flag set: two different recordings meet on V1 at 0:07. The recording's right-click has one Transition… row and no Fade In, Fade Out or Fade In and Out; it opens the tiles At this cut, naming both clips, every tile showing the two recordings themselves and the one under the pointer playing. Cube picked from its tile goes on the cut. The cut's own right-click opens the same tiles and offers nothing about one clip's fade. The recording's free start still fades from black by the handle on its bar. The user, 2026-10-29: 'these are super redundant and one sided. wondering if there is a nicer way to select a transition between 2 clips'.
